# دفتر ترجمه رسمی دکتر زاهدی (Dr. Zahedi Official Translation Office)

> Official certified translator office in Kerman, Iran (Judiciary license No. 1162). Provides certified Persian↔English translation of official documents (birth/marriage/divorce certificates, academic transcripts, power of attorney, employment and bank certificates, vehicle and real estate ownership deeds, military service cards, police clearance certificates, single-status certificates), NAATI-certified translation for Australian immigration, interpretation services, and courier-based service for other cities in Kerman province.

## Key pages

- [Services](https://zahedicto.ir/services.html): full list of official translation services.
- [Pricing guide](https://zahedicto.ir/translation-pricing-kerman.html): how official translation fees are set in Iran (judiciary-mandated annual tariff).
- [Official vs. unofficial translation](https://zahedicto.ir/official-vs-unofficial-translation.html): when certified translation is legally required.
- [Complete guide to official translation in Kerman](https://zahedicto.ir/official-translation-guide-kerman.html): comprehensive overview.
- [NAATI-certified translation](https://zahedicto.ir/naati-certified-translation-kerman.html): for Australian visa/immigration/education purposes.
- [FAQ](https://zahedicto.ir/faq.html): common questions about cost, turnaround time, and required documents.
- [Immigration news](https://zahedicto.ir/immigration-news.html): daily updates on Australia and Canada immigration policy.
- [Contact](https://zahedicto.ir/contact.html): address, phone, and hours.

## Basic facts

- Judiciary-licensed office, license No. 1162.
- Location: Kerman, Iran — خیابان فیروزه، بین فیروزه ۴ و ۶.
- Phone: +98 34 32532141.
- Languages: Persian to English and English to Persian.
- Fees follow Iran's judiciary-mandated annual translation tariff (uniform nationwide, not set by individual offices).
